reviews.text: We are so happy we found Monty’s! It really changed our life! We tried a few other daycares around Amsterdam, but our dog, Puk, seems to have finally found her spot. She gets so excited each morning the Monty’s van shows up to collect her. Ryan and Anthony are so kind & great to communicate with and the dogs love them. They really have created a happy and peaceful place. Can highly recommend
Antisocial driving behavior.

Absolutely amazing! I can highly recommend Monty's Doggy Daycare to every dog owner with high standards for their dog. It is one of the highlights of the week for our dog. The communication with us, dedication and love for our dog are truly amazing. Our dog has the best time, and we can relax knowing that he's safe and enjoying his day.

Monty’s didn’t just watch our dog - they transformed her!!!

​Roxy (our Aussiedoodle) goes to Monty’s 2–3 times a week, and it is easily the best decision we’ve ever made for her. Before Monty's, leaving the house without her was an absolute non-starter.

​After a gentle 1–2 week adjustment period, she blossomed. She’s now so independent, extremely confident, and gets so hyped when the van arrives in the morning!!

On our regular walks, barking dogs don't even phase her anymore, yet her park social skills are top-tier!

​She’s happy, confident, and clearly feels right at home (as evidenced by her stealing the front seat in the van photo!). We couldn't ask for better care for our girl!!

Thanks to Ryan and Anthony for the care! And the videos!!

Very caring, friendly doggy Daycare! Anthony and Ryan are so amazingly helpful and friendly! And most importantly, they take very good care of our dog. Our puppy had to get used a bit to the new daycare environment and they always take time to have a talk with us how it went and what they did to make him feel comfortable. They know what they are doing! Now our dog has learned a lot about doggy behavior from the other dogs, which is really helpful for his development.

We’re absolutely delighted with Monty’s and our dog Pippin even more so. They’re reliable, friendly, professional and most of all: they seem to just love dogs. It’s not overly crowded for dogs, they’re not in it to make as much as possible but to give the animals a happy time. Definitely recommended.
Highly recommended! Leo is always super happy when he gets to go to Monty’s. Ryan and Anthony are very sweet to the dogs and organize Monty’s really well. We are so glad we found Monty’s!

Choosing a daycare for your dog is a big decision, but we knew from the start we had found the right place. Our dog has been going there for 1.5 years, and he still gets so excited every time he sees the daycare van. That says it all!

Anthony and Ryan have built something really special. They truly care about every dog, and it shows in everything they do. The videos they share are always the highlight of my day and it’s wonderful to see how happy our boy is.

Thank you, Anthony and Ryan, for taking such amazing care of our boy. We couldn’t recommend you more highly!
Our dog has been going to Monty's weekly for 1.5 years and loves it. Picking him up is easy, the Monty's team is great, and most importantly: Max is exhausted when he comes home. Highly recommended!

Monty's is the bomb.com! Our dog cannot wait to jump in the van when being picked up in the morning. She comes back tired and happy from a lovely day on the farm with all other other wonderful dogs!
Couldnt recommend them enough!

My dog prefers to go with Ryan and Anthony to Monty’s Doggy Day care than staying with me. That says it all..! I am very overprotective of my dog and the guys just made it so smooth for both of us from day 1. Super professional, communication 10/10, photos through the day, flexible too! Lu loves it, everytime she hears a van she goes so happy ❤️ thank you!

Monty’s has been a huge help for us. Back in the US doggy daycare is a much larger business and when we moved to AMS we struggled with care for our dog. When we found Monty’s it was a great solution.

For a very reasonable price, they pick up Andie in the AM and return her tired and happy in the afternoon.

The boys - as we affectionately refer to them - always send pictures and videos of Andie during her day and while she’s there she is having the most fun. They also make sure her weird personality and quirks get addressed - like riding shotgun in the pickup van. We never worry about her safety while she’s there and know she’s in safe hands.

We highly recommend them!
Flip and Billie are always so so so excited to come and have made many friends at Monty’s! Also Ryan and Anthony are the sweetest! ❤️🐶

We’re so happy we found Monty’s for our dog Charlie, this place is amazing! Communication with Ryan and Anthony is always super good. Also love the videos and pictures they share during the day! The only sad thing is that our dog prefers spending time with them and the other dogs at Monty’s versus with us ;). He is jumping from happiness as soon as we get close to the Monty’s van that picks him up. Thank you guys for all the great care!

We ❤️ Monty’s.
Our two year old rescue, Max, is incredibly happy and well taken care of. Due to past trauma, our pup is not good with strangers and can be incredibly anxious - but there is he so happy and care free. The team have a wonderful approach and you can tell they really care for, and put the dog’s wellbeing first!

My dog Rufus genuinely loves his time at Monty's.  He races to where he knows the van is going to pick him up and every day he returns happy and exhausted from his time playing with his pack.  I consider Monty's to be an invaluable service.

Highly recommend Monty’s Doggy Daycare! The team is so kind with the dogs and seeing our dog enjoying it makes us really happy :-)
The service is great, friendly and reliable. 5/5 stars!

I wholeheartedly recommend Monty’s. All the employees are so kind to all the dogs, and we really feel our puppy is taken care of and always comes home having had the best time!

It’s truly the best money we could be spending for ourselves as well as for our dog!!

I cannot recommend Monty’s Doggy Day Care highly enough. Ryan, Anthony, and the entire Monty’s crew are truly incredible.

As a nervous dog mom, finding the right daycare was so important to me, and Monty’s has exceeded every expectation. The love and dedication they have for what they do is so clear. This is absolutely not just a job to them. They care deeply about every single dog that attends, and that level of care gives such peace of mind.

Hank is obsessed with the team and with the friends he’s made there, which says everything. The pick up and drop off service makes my life so much easier and completely worry free, knowing he is in the best hands from start to finish.

When I first got Hank, I tried a few different places to see where he would fit best, and I am so grateful I discovered Monty’s. It was immediately clear this was the right environment for him.

They truly are the best in Amsterdam, if not the Netherlands. I would highly recommend Monty’s to anyone looking for a safe, loving, and genuinely exceptional daycare for their dog.

We've always been unsure about using doggy daycare but we’ve had such a great experience with Monty’s. They are always organised and on time, as well as always kind and loving to our dog. We can tell our dog enjoys his time there every week and comes back completely knackered every time. It’s also been great for his experience with other dogs and he has gotten so much more confident around bigger dogs. Thanks Monty’s!
The boys are amazing. Our dog gets excited every time he sees a white van haha. Premium service and care. 100% recommended

My dog(Roedi) and me both love Montys daycare.
Roedi gets super excited on seeing the van that comes to pick him up. He spends his energy properly in the farm and comes as a happy tired dog. Every one in the staff is really very kind and good with dogs. I sent Roedi there to also improve on his socialisation and it is working too.

Honestly, Monty’s has been an absolute lifesaver (and sanity-saver). After moving to Amsterdam, I struggled to find good daycare for my Italian greyhound, LilV. He’s sweet but a bit of a diva. And Monty’s totally get him.

I love how organised they are. I get a text the night before with pick-up and drop-off times, plus photo and video updates during the day (which always make me smile mid-work). Working full-time, I really appreciate the peace of Mind Monty’s gives me, knowing LilV’s happy, safe, and spoiled in the best way.

Can’t recommend them enough!

By far the best Doggy day care business in town. Anthony & Ryan are also absolutely lovely and give so much time, love and attention to all of the dogs they look after. We trust our dog with them completely and get lots of regular videos throughout the day which we love!! The tradition of celebrating the dogs Birthday with sing alongs & cake is also a personal favourite! Highly recommend!!
Our dog loves his time at Montys. They are super professional and look after the dogs very well.

Raising a golden retriever puppy while working full time is a tough job... so when we met dog owners in the park that told us about Monty's, we immediately booked our meet and greet.

We have been sending our golden retriever puppy to Monty's over the last few months.

Collection and drop off is reliable. She is so excited to jump into the school bus when it arrives - she goes straight into her own crate.

While she gets to spend her puppy energy, she also learns how to play and interact with dogs of all ages and sizes - the socialisation benefits have been amazing.

We get regular pupdates (photos, videos) and they are transparent about how her day was. Every dog gets the love and attention they deserve.

Anthony, Ryan and team provide an impeccable daycare service. We have peace of mind that our pup is safe and happy.

Monty’s Doggy Daycare is highly recommended. Anthony, Ryan, and the team are super friendly and helpful. Communication is always good, and the pick-up and drop-off service with live tracking is excellent. Additionally, the daily videos you receive are a joy to watch. And most importantly, of course, our dog loves going to Monty’s.

We absolutely love Monty’s! Our dog Moxie has the best time when he’s there. The pickup / drop off service is so slick and smooth and we love getting photo and video updates throughout the day of Moxie enjoying life with his doggy pals. I really trust the Monty’s team to take excellent care of the dogs and would recommend them to anyone. Thank you Monty’s!

We couldn’t be happier with Monty’s in Amsterdam! The staff are warm, caring, and always take wonderful care of our pup, who absolutely loves going there. We really appreciate the daily updates and videos. It’s clear the team truly cares. Highly recommend!
Super recommend! Friendly, responsible, accommodating and caring. My dog really really enjoys going to Monty’s!

We love Monty’s! Homer gets picked up each morning and dropped off in the evening happy, tired, and clearly well cared for. Ryan and Anthony are wonderful - friendly, professional, and always sharing lovely updates throughout the day. The pick-up and drop-off service makes everything so easy, and it’s amazing value for the level of care and attention they provide ◡̈

We have been using Monty’s twice a week since moving in Amsterdam and highly recommend it! Our dog loves going and comes back happy and tired each evening. The collection and drop off process is super efficient (you get a time slot and a live location) which is super useful and Anthony and Ryan are wonderful. Highly recommend and the best doggy day care in Amsterdam!

Our dog Benya has been going to Monty’s for a few months now, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. Benya absolutely loves going to Monty’s. The moment we get close, she gets visibly excited—tail wagging, eager to jump out of the car. It’s obvious she loves being there.

The care and attention she receives are outstanding. Benya is always well looked after and comes home happy and tired after a full day of play with the other dogs. She truly feels at home.

The owners are amazing—warm, professional, and clearly devoted to the dogs they care for. We have complete trust in them.

Monty’s has become a second home for Benya, and we’re so grateful for it. Highly recommended! 🐾

Really nice doggy daycare! Our dog really likes it and gets very excited when she gets picked up in the morning despite normally being very sceptical of people. We also receive pictures and videos throughout the days and she seems to really enjoy it. Strongly recommended.
Jimmy is getting used to going to Monty’s, people are so sweet with the doggies

Great dog daycare, your puppy can just be a puppy and will be watched over with loving eyes. You will also be kept informed throughout the day and they have an extra service where your dog will be picked up and returned within the A10.
Blue’s favourite spot for the day

Hands down the best experience with the team at Monty's!  Our pup just loves her days at Monty's and always comes back so tired from play.  There are photo and video updates throughout the day, and the pickup and dropoff are so easy.  We could not be happier!

Monty's and the guys who run it are just the best. Our dog (one-year old cavapoo) could not be more excited when he sees the van come to pick him up in the morning, his tail wags so much his whole body follows. He comes back in the afternoon tired and content, having socialised and played while we have managed to have full days of work while getting video updates from the farm throughout, creating little pockets of joy. We really could not recommend Monty's doggy daycare more.

It's the best daycare my dog could probably have!
Whenever she goes, I know she will come back really happy and tired. During the day they send lots of pics and videos (along with funny subtitles 😂).
Their communication is perfect for every step, planning, pick up, drop off and on the day care. They are also really attentive and kind.

Thank you so much Ryan and Anthony for taking so good care of Abigail!

Monty’s is hands down the best dog daycare in Amsterdam. They pick up Mimi in the morning and bring her back eight hours later, happy, tired, and well cared for. Ryan and Anthony are incredibly professional, kind, and attentive, always sharing the sweetest updates throughout the day. Their service is top-notch, and I can’t recommend them enough—10/10!

This is a great service! The owners are kind and reliable. The dogs have lots of space on the farm. Scheduling and pickup are easy. The photos and videos I receive during the day are heartwarming and reassuring. Definite recommendation.

These guys are the best! Great communication and they care for the dogs with skill and ensure a positive play environment for them. They are head and shoulders above our other experiences in Amsterdam.

Best doggy daycare in Amsterdam by far!! We went Otis to a few options before and he came back nervous or barking but once we sent him to Monty’s he was overjoyed, he looks forward to jumping in the van every week and comes back a happy restful dog! Amazing service picking him up and dropping him off straight in our flat - game changer! Plus all the photos and videos we get during the day - too cute!

Thank you so much Ryan and Anthony for being such a loving team with the dogs and so organised and communicative. Highly recommend!

Our dog Paddy has been going to Monty's for months and he absolutely loves it! He is super excited going down to meet the bus. Anthony & Ryan send us lovely videos of Paddy running around, enjoying himself with his buddies. We're so happy with the care & attention that Paddy receives. Anthony & Ryan are such great people! Highly recommend and would give more stars if we could!
Incredible place! Thank you for everything and couldn’t recommend it more highly! 🫶🫶🫶🫶🫶🫶 …
Great initiative from two of the kindest guys. Beautiful location. Wishing them all the succes and growth! (without overgrowing). Love the loving and caretaking spirit for the dogs ❤️

We're so happy with Monty's Doggy Daycare. We've been sending our dog there for a few months now and it's reliable, convenient, safe and she loves it. It's really the best solution we've found in 4 years to days where we both need to be at the office.

I couldn’t recommend Montys doggy daycare more, my puppy absolutely loves it there and has made so many friends! He started going 3 months ago and it has been amazing for his development, he is now super social with other dogs and waits at the window for the van in the mornings.
Anthony and Ryan are super stars, a seamless service offered every time with spot on communication. I think this is just the best dog daycare and I am so grateful!

100% recommend! My dog, Kaia, loves it there! Anthony and Ryan take great care of the dogs and make them feel at home. Kaia is generally scared of men, but Anthony and Ryan are her besties! We receive multiple photo and video updates during the day which is very fun and exciting. I keep checking my phone to see if another update has arrived! Pick up and drop off service is great, especially if you have a bit of a longer office day. The guys drop your little angel in your house 🐶

Ryan & Anthony have done such a great job opening Montys! I can't believe its only been 5 months as the whole operation is really seamless & professionally run. Our Billie always loves spending the day there and the communication and photos/videos recieved during the day always feels so personal & genuine.

We LOVE Monty’s so much! We send our puppy Billie there and she always comes back happy and exhausted - not easy with an Australian shepherd! They always send a ton of videos and photos so we know our girl is in great hands all day.

My English Cocker Spaniel Baloo has been going to Monty’s for about 2 months now, and it’s been an amazing experience! Anthony and Ryan are very communicative and friendly, and knowing Baloo is such good hands puts my mind at ease. I …

This the best daycare in Amsterdam and surroundings. Such a dedication and love for the dogs. It’s way more then just a daycare. These guys really take care of the dogs the whole stay and give you fun updates during the day. You are amazing guys!

My 3 year old rescue Ori comes here 2-3 times a week. As soon as I grab his lunchbox in the morning it’s only but happy awoo’s until he gets to go into the van. Anthony and Ryan are the best! They make sure your dog gets the attention and …
